name: manual_deb085
claim: When verifying a git merge/cherry-pick has zero remaining conflicts, never rely on grep for '<<<<<<<' text markers alone -- rename/delete, add/add, and delete/modify conflicts leave no textual markers, only unresolved index stages. Use 'git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U' (empty output = truly resolved) as the authoritative check, or grep all six conflict porcelain codes (UU AA DD AU UA DU UD), not just three.

decisions.notes: Caught 2026-07-30 during periscope PR#35 dual-lineage merge: verified '0 conflict markers' via grep '^<<<<<<<' across the whole repo and declared the merge fully resolved (build/test verified, PR opened). Attempting the actual merge commit failed -- 3 files (cmd/periscope/pricing_schedule.go and its 2 test files) were still unmerged with AU status (added-by-us, deleted-by-them via rename tracking), invisible to marker-grep since delete/modify and add/add conflicts never get inline <<<<<<< text. Only git's own diff-filter=U (or the full 6-code porcelain check) catches every conflict type.
